title: Chapter 103 Beheading Tactics
content:
Chapter 103 Beheading Tactics

After this round of blows, the barbarians on the city wall were panicked, their morale was low, and they were on the point of mutiny and flight at any time!

The leader of the alliance can only let them, the soldiers who are temporarily unable to fight, all withdraw from the city, and replace them with another group of people who have not experienced war to replace their defense, so as not to be broken through the city wall for this reason.

However, they certainly did not expect that these crossbow formations were far from over, and that there would be more powerful catapults and ballistas, which were more powerful engineering equipment for Chen Qiang, in turn.

Throughout the day, the entire city wall was occupied by roaring boulders, which fell like meteors. In order to defeat these barbarians at once, Zhong Yu dispatched 1,000 catapults from the rear, and prepared enough boulders as ammunition .

These catapults and boulders do not need to consume luck points, they can be made completely with the technology of the Three Kingdoms, but now Zhong Yu throws them into the barbarian city as if they don't want money.

The entire city is covered with deep pits smashed by boulders, or the remains of destroyed buildings. Plasma is everywhere on the city walls, which is the scene caused by the corpses of barbarians being crushed into flesh by boulders.

This scene lasted him for three days, every moment, every minute, every second, huge stones were thrown into the city, day and night, without any rest time, until three days later, all the trebuchets and ballistas were thrown into the city because of the long time The work was stopped only after it was completely scrapped.

And at that moment, the entire city was already in disrepair, the city walls collapsed in countless places, and there were huge boulders everywhere inside and outside the city, piled up together, blocking traffic.

And it's not that those barbarians didn't think about organizing elite soldiers, summoning a group of superpowers to fight out of the city, implementing a beheading tactic, and directly destroying these trebuchets, so that Zhong Yu's army would have no more means of attacking the city. It can implement the primitive tactics of ants attaching to siege.

But without exception, all of them were repelled by Zhong Yu's crossbow troops who were preparing to protect those catapults outside the city with waves of arrows that could pierce their vindictive shields. Many people.

Of course, in order to repel those barbarians with extraordinary strength, the crossbowmen, who originally had more than 10,000 people, were killed by more than 300 barbarian assault teams, killing more than 1,000 of them, which can be described as a heavy loss.

After those barbarians found that this method was not feasible, they gave up decisively and quickly returned to the city before the enemy army came to surround them. They only lost more than 50 people who were killed or injured when they were hit by the crossbow array just now.

After that, he never came out again, just hid in the city and waited for the catapults and boulders of Zhong Yu's army to run out, and then he would settle the account.

This time came soon, and three days later, seeing that the morale and strength of the barbarians had been shattered, Zhong Yu finally ordered the army to go out to fight a decisive battle with them.

The two armies made an appointment together to set up a formation on the plain and have a decisive battle. Zhong Yu didn't need those siege equipment, and those barbarians couldn't hide in the city and act like turtles, and directly use their own bravery to decide the battle. One win.

The flags are flying and the wind is whistling. On the battlefield, there are huge crowds of people. The two sides are divided into two camps, and they line up separately. One side has a large number of people and is well-equipped. Every soldier looks excited and eager to fight. There are 200,000 people in him, but it is Zhong Yu's army. .

The other side was much more miserable, and there was no uniform clothing. Many people just wore a piece of animal skin, took a wooden weapon and went to the battlefield hastily. The number of people was much smaller, only a few more than 10,000 Nearly 20,000 people.

Many people were still wounded, and their faces were a little pale and frightened, but there were also people with anger and fighting spirit on their faces, full of expectations for this war, but in general, from the perspective of the overall morale equipment and personnel quality of both sides, those barbaric People still seem to be at a disadvantage!

The decisive battle began soon. Following the order of the leaders of both sides, soldiers from both sides threw themselves into the frontal battlefield one by one, fell into the battle formation, and began to fight for their own destiny in this meat grinder!

When they were relying on their own personal strength, many barbarians had an advantage at the beginning, because there were many people with extraordinary strength who possessed fighting spirit in their army.

Using these people as pioneers to implement a small-scale tactical breakthrough brought a lot of trouble to Zhong Yu's army, which had never experienced such personal bravery and was so powerful that it defies the sky.

But soon, Zhong Yu's well-educated officers reorganized the fighting spirit of the soldiers, let them cooperate with each other to kill them, and used their lives to drag those extraordinary powers back.

As the battle progressed, batch after batch of soldiers were filled in, and the few barbarians soon discovered that they had no one to fill the battlefield and make up for the gaps in the front lines of all sides!

The barbarians, who fell into a numerical disadvantage, were quickly surrounded by an increasing number of Zhong Yu's army. They besieged from all directions, and the number of casualties suddenly increased, and the situation on the entire battlefield became precarious.

Seeing that his army would collapse and be annihilated in a short time if it continued like this, the patriarch of the Edel tribe roared, and led his 300 personal guards as the last batch of reinforcements, and personally went to the battlefield to support!

The patriarch of the Edel tribe is a Tier 4 powerhouse, and his strength is naturally not comparable to that of ordinary Tier 3 players. As soon as he entered the field, he opened up the situation.

He led his subordinates who had undergone his strict training, strong discipline, and the strength of the first-level personal guards quickly broke through to stop their imperial army, and broke through the entire army formation at once, giving Zhong Yu's army operation caused great hindrance.

He and the patriarch showed great power, wielding the epee with both hands wantonly, every time it fell, he would take away several lives, but after a while, there were hundreds of people who died in his hands, and this number is still there. The efficiency of several human lives per second increases rapidly.

And the soldiers behind the patriarch also used their patriarch to disrupt the organization and cooperation of the soldiers under Zhong Yu's command, and took advantage of the situation to cover up and kill them. With their first-level strength, it really caused a great effect.

A big gap was opened in the entire defense line. Wherever the barbarian army passed, not a single soldier of Zhong Yu could survive. Thousands of soldiers in the entire battlefield area either fled or died.

In this way, wherever the patriarch of the Edel tribe passed along the way, the imperial soldiers who had been frightened by him gave way one after another, and opened a road wide enough for his 300 troops to pass, allowing him to roam freely on the entire battlefield , The situation on the battlefield eroded instantly.

In other places, the barbarian soldiers who were beaten back because of the small number of people on their side, saw that their leader was so brave, and defeated the imperial soldiers who they thought were invincible in one fell swoop.

Their morale was greatly boosted, and their fighting spirit rose all of a sudden. Relying on the bloody courage in their bodies, they once again killed the enemy army on the opposite side, and suppressed Zhong Yu's army in turn for a while.

And all of this is not the most terrifying thing. What is really scary is that the patriarch led his personal guards to kill Zhong Yu's imperial guard with a goal, intending to capture and kill Zhong Yu in one fell swoop, so as to defeat this disparate force. war!
